Assertions: identifies hard constraints and their effect; may separate soft preferences; enumerates allowed/disallowed conditions. Exclusion: merely restates task text without operational constraint structure; no distinction.

Parameters: observation (data showing inconsistency), reasoning (detection and resolution).
Assertions: observation content conflicts with expected mapping/assumption; reasoning explicitly flags; adopts robust/conservative interpretation. Exclusion: reasoning ignores or normalizes discrepancy; no inconsistency; picks one interpretation arbitrarily without rationale.

candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses an intended future action or sequence of actions.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended action or plan.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies at least one intended future action or sequence of actions.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports completed actions or conclusions without expressing a future intention.

candidate_predicates.name: SEPARATES_HARD_CONSTRAINTS_FROM_SOFT_PREFERENCES
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly classifies requirements into binding constraints that any acceptable solution must satisfy and soft preferences that may be used only to choose among otherwise valid solutions, and states or applies that precedence.

parameters.name: constraint_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that classifies requirements and establishes how hard constraints and soft preferences are to be applied.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one binding constraint and at least one soft preference.
The reasoning states or makes clear that binding constraints filter acceptable solutions before preferences are applied.
Preferences are characterized as lower-priority or tie-breaking criteria rather than mandatory requirements.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats soft preferences as mandatory constraints or treats binding constraints as optional.
The reasoning does not distinguish between binding constraints and preferences.
The reasoning merely restates requirements without establishing precedence between hard constraints and preferences.

candidate_predicates.name: AGGREGATES_MULTIPLE_OBSERVATIONS_INTO_JOINT_CONSTRAINT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning combines information from multiple observations into a single joint constraint or model that must hold collectively for all represented entities, rather than treating each observation as an independent local fact.

parameters.name: synthesis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that combines information from multiple observations into a joint constraint or model.

parameters.name: source_observations
parameters.description: The observations whose contents are jointly combined into the shared constraint or model.

assertion_conditions: At least two observations provide relevant source data.
The reasoning explicitly unions, merges, or otherwise combines their information into one joint constraint or model.
The combined constraint is applied collectively to all entities represented by the observations.
exclusion_conditions: The observations are used only independently or locally.
Only one observation contributes relevant information.
No joint constraint or shared model is formed.

candidate_predicates.name: RESOLVES_OBSERVED_INCONSISTENCY_CONSERVATIVELY
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning detects a mismatch or inconsistency in observed data relative to labels, expectations, or assumed structure, evaluates multiple interpretations, and adopts an interpretation that remains valid under the plausible alternatives.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observed data containing the mismatch or inconsistency.

parameters.name: resolution_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies the inconsistency, evaluates interpretations, and selects a conservative resolution.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains a mismatch or inconsistency relative to labels, expected structure, or prior assumptions.
The reasoning explicitly notices the mismatch or inconsistency.
The reasoning compares plausible interpretations and adopts one that remains valid under those alternatives.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning does not notice the mismatch or inconsistency.
The observed discrepancy is irrelevant to the task or to the adopted interpretation.
An interpretation is chosen without considering alternative plausible readings.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning draws a conclusion using identifiable information from the observation as supporting evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing the evidence-based conclusion.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying evidence for that conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion supported by identifiable content from the observation.
The observation contributes evidential support to the stated conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the conclusion or provides no identifiable support.

candidate_predicates.name: SELECTS_OPTIMAL_CANDIDATE_BY_EXPLICIT_ORDERING
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning compares multiple candidate solutions, eliminates candidates that violate binding constraints, and selects the remaining candidate that is optimal under an explicit ordering criterion such as earliest valid time.

parameters.name: selection_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that compares candidates, eliminates invalid ones, and selects an optimal candidate according to a stated ordering.

assertion_conditions: Multiple candidate solutions are enumerated or compared.
Candidates that violate binding constraints are explicitly or inferably eliminated.
An explicit ordering criterion is stated or applied.
The selected candidate is the optimal remaining candidate under that ordering.
exclusion_conditions: Only one candidate solution is considered.
The selection is arbitrary or unsupported by an ordering criterion.
No candidate elimination based on binding constraints occurs.
The stated ordering is not used to choose among candidates.

candidate_predicates.name: IMPLEMENTS_DECISION_AS_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: The action creates or writes an artifact whose content is specified by a decision or computed result in the reasoning, thereby materializing that decision.

parameters.name: decision_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the concrete decision or computed specification to be materialized.

parameters.name: implementation_action
parameters.description: The action that creates or writes the artifact implementing the decision.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning contains a concrete decision or computed specification.
The action creates or writes an artifact.
The artifact content corresponds to the decision or specification in the reasoning.
exclusion_conditions: The action only reads, explores, or inspects existing resources.
The created artifact is unrelated to the decision in the reasoning.
No concrete decision or specification is present in the reasoning.

candidate_predicates.name: PREPARES_VALIDATION_PROCEDURE
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning defines checks or expected conditions for validating a produced solution, and the action creates a reusable test or check procedure embodying those checks.

parameters.name: validation_plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that specifies the validation checks or expected conditions.

parameters.name: procedure_creation_action
parameters.description: The action that creates the test or check procedure embodying those validation criteria.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates validation checks or expected conditions.
The action creates a reusable test or check procedure embodying those checks.
The procedure is intended to assess a produced solution against requirements.
exclusion_conditions: The action creates the final solution artifact rather than a validation procedure.
No explicit validation checks or expected conditions are specified.
The created procedure is unrelated to assessing the solution.

candidate_predicates.name: RUNS_VALIDATION_PROCEDURE
candidate_predicates.definition: The action executes a validation or test procedure against a produced solution to determine whether stated requirements are met.

parameters.name: validation_action
parameters.description: The action executing the validation or test procedure.

assertion_conditions: The action invokes a test or check procedure.
The procedure evaluates a produced solution against stated requirements.
The resulting outcome is expected to be interpretable as pass or fail.
exclusion_conditions: The action gathers source data rather than evaluating a solution.
The action creates an artifact rather than executing a validation procedure.
The command is not a validation or check procedure.

candidate_predicates.name: DIAGNOSES_FAILURE_AND_CORRECTS_CAUSE
candidate_predicates.definition: An observation reports a failure or error, the reasoning identifies a specific cause in the procedure or artifact, and the corrective action modifies that procedure or artifact to address the identified cause.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting an error, exception, or failed check.

parameters.name: diagnostic_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying a specific cause of the observed failure.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The action modifying the failing procedure or artifact to address the identified cause.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an error, exception, or failed check.
The reasoning identifies a specific cause in the procedure or artifact.
The corrective action modifies that procedure or artifact to address the identified cause.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports success rather than failure.
The reasoning only restates the failure without identifying a cause.
The action retries the same procedure unchanged or changes an unrelated element.
The alleged cause is not connected to the modification.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_SOLUTION_WITH_VALIDATION_RESULT
candidate_predicates.definition: The observation reports that a validation procedure completed successfully with all required checks passing, and the reasoning accepts the produced solution as satisfying the requirements on that basis.

parameters.name: validation_result_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the validation procedure.

parameters.name: acceptance_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that accepts the solution as satisfying requirements based on the successful validation result.

assertion_conditions: The observation explicitly reports that a validation procedure passed all required checks.
The reasoning acknowledges that result and treats the produced solution as satisfying the requirements.
No unresolved failure remains in the validation outcome.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports failure, partial success, or an ambiguous outcome.
The reasoning only notes the result without accepting the solution.
Success is inferred from the execution attempt alone rather than from the reported result.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_INPUT_INTEGRITY
candidate_predicates.definition: An action inspects metadata, checksums, or contents of input resources to determine whether they remain unmodified, the observation supplies integrity evidence, and the reasoning concludes that the inputs were not altered.

parameters.name: integrity_check_action
parameters.description: The action retrieving metadata, checksums, or listings for the input resources.

parameters.name: integrity_evidence_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing metadata, checksums, listings, or other evidence about input integrity.

parameters.name: integrity_conclusion_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning concluding from the evidence that the input resources were not modified.

assertion_conditions: A requirement or concern exists that input resources remain unmodified.
The action retrieves metadata, checksums, listings, or other integrity-relevant information about those inputs.
The observation supplies that integrity evidence.
The reasoning concludes that the inputs were not altered.
exclusion_conditions: No integrity requirement or concern is present.
The action modifies the input resources.
The observation does not provide evidence about input integrity.
The conclusion is asserted without supporting evidence.
